# Certificate fixtures

Pinned by `../fixtures_verify.rs` and `crates/wipe-cli` tests. No test reads
this file: `fixtures_verify.rs`
(`the_v2_erased_fixture_verifies_with_the_published_station_key`) and
`crates/wipe-cli/tests/verify_cert_fixture.rs` carry the station and
supervisor public keys below as their own literals, which must equal this
table. The first verifies `v2-erased.json` with that literal; the second runs
the built `wipestation verify-cert --public-key-b64 <station key>` on both v2
files and expects the supervisor key to be refused. **Never edit or
regenerate the v2 files**: they are the only proof that certificates signed
before schema v3 still verify.

| File | Format | Generated by | Signed with |
|---|---|---|---|
| `v2-erased.json` | v2 | baseline `7871e67` (a throwaway test, since deleted): mock NVMe Job erased, `Certificate::from_job` | station key |
| `v2-destroyed-cosigned.json` | v2 | baseline `7871e67`: mock SATA Job whose erasure failed, recorded for destruction with a Shred attestation (story 2), certified as the baseline generator did at pending destruction, then `co_sign`ed as Supervisor | station key; co-signature by supervisor key |
| `v3-destroyed.json` | v3 | `fixtures_verify.rs` `regenerate_v3_fixture` (ignored test; rerun only when v3 changes on purpose): first Job of a three-drive scanned run, Shred at Moderate, completed with policy `none` | station key |
| `v3-destroyed-witness.json` | v3 | same ignored test: one-drive scanned run, Melt at Low, completed by Ana Ruiz, then witnessed by Bo Chen (witness policy) | station key |

Keys (Ed25519, `wipe_cert::SigningKey::from_seed`):

| Key | Seed | Public key (`--public-key-b64`) | `public_key_id` |
|---|---|---|---|
| station | `[42; 32]` | `GX9rI+FshTLGq8g4+s1ep4m+DHaykgM0A5v6iz02jWE` | `ed25519:tgAwbPp2cj/ew5XlOps9nw` |
| supervisor | `[43; 32]` | `RQigeqlBcH8+stuUyIl6gLLBGXR2tt4hOsJz332GxP8` | `ed25519:JvPPxOR/cDZmchQTzgfFDw` |

SHA-256 of the v2 files as generated at baseline (`shasum -a 256 v2-*.json`):

```
d2e38419cc6fdb3721ff6e8dd4d9442393bc0e004ae970be311580186ee5ccfa  v2-destroyed-cosigned.json
39ba35a6311607a89188dee013179c8a7ba1d7e52c3c152ca76f96e5332f3bb2  v2-erased.json
```
